props.text:
BTC 2026 technical bottom analysis—volume profile breakdown across Q1-Q3 with DCA entry zones:
- Q1 value zone: 62-64K (limited time window, 2 days around Iran war event)
- Q2 momentum: bidirectional strength, 76-78K trapped shorts/longs
- Q3 sustained: 62-64K dominant (months to accumulate), despite rejections at POC 67K in summer; 50s showed stubborn spot demand even at peak STRC euphoria
- Key thesis: 50K *absolutely* a great zone—multiple test opportunities in Q4 expected if market revisits; suspended-loading setup for whichever direction breaks (70-72K or 50s for DCA)
